reviewFindingsAddressed: No top-level missing implementation import; all seven tests execute independently.
Test symbols and expected failure signatures exactly match the plan sidecar.
RuntimeConfigStore assertions are owned by AC-2 and AC-7 main test symbols.
AC-6 uses scanner-generated inventory rather than manually supplied repository keys or paths.
Candidate stability is resolved through the trusted registry rather than caller declaration.
Only implementation-module import failure is translated to the sidecar RED signature; body assertion and I/O failures remain unwrapped.
Manifest declaration and repository inventory discovery use independent APIs and inputs, with hard-coded known anchors preventing self-consistent scanner shortcuts.
AC-2 and AC-7 derive expected decisions and byte snapshots outside the observation result instead of trusting self-reported parity booleans.
AC-2 and AC-7 deep-compare the exact eleven planned consumer IDs to legacy policy IDs, rejecting empty, missing, or additional keys.
The RED signature wrapper accepts only ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND whose URL exactly equals TerminalResourcePolicy.js; dependency, syntax, evaluation, assertion, and I/O errors remain unchanged.
